original_test_intent: Validate HGX PCIe D3 power-management interoperability by proving every approved NVQual Test #31 function enters the intended D3 state and wakes to full link, NVIDIA identity and driver/function health within deadline without hang, unplanned reboot or error.
original_method: Pin D3hot versus D3cold, function and power-resource topology, quiesce, entry method, wake source, enumeration/link/driver restoration, latency, iterations, error acceptance and final policy; preserve baselines; record each complete power transaction before the next; stop on first fault and recover out of band.
manual_activity: HGX owner/FAE approves D3 state, function/power scope, wake and iterations; an operator isolates the SUT and owns policy restoration and recovery if the GPU/function fails to return.
required_inputs: Pinned NVQual Test #31 D3 configuration and compatible firmware/driver
D3hot/D3cold, consumer quiesce, entry, wake source, enumeration/link/driver/function restoration and latency rules
Iterations/timing, error acceptance, final policy, storage, aborts and recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production HGX SUT and explicit D3/power-resource authorization
No unsaved workload; consumers quiesced; verified BMC/console recovery
Do not force D3cold or remove shared power without approved scope
Stop on failed entry/wake, missing/unhealthy function, link loss/downtraining, driver failure, hang/reboot, new AER, thermal/power fault, tool failure or evidence gap
No forced rebind, reset/power escalation, evidence clearing or retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate Test #31 recipe, D3 capability, function/power topology, baseline, interlocks and recovery
Run only approved D3 entry/wake cycles
Commit D-state/resource/wake/latency/enumeration/link/driver/function/error evidence before the next cycle
Do not infer D3 variant, cut shared power, retry faults or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Test #31 recipe, D3 variant, function/power-resource scope and iterations
Review all cycles and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It identifies D3 but generic link/device snapshots cannot prove D-state entry, resource condition, wake or functional recovery, and it omits D3hot/D3cold scope.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the pinned Test #31 configuration with an atomic ledger and block cycle N+1 until N proves intended D state/resource condition, wake, enumeration/link/driver/function restoration, latency and acceptable errors.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #31, D3 power management, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/300-minute allocation remain; missing states and counts are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL INTERLOCKED HGX D3 POWER MANAGEMENT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each D3 cycle as a function power transaction covering quiesce, state/resource entry, wake, link and driver/function restoration, latency and platform health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds D3 variant, power-resource scope, functional recovery, durable transaction evidence, first-fault inhibition, restoration and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final enumerated link cannot prove D3 entry, power removal, wake latency, driver/function recovery or earlier transient faults.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong D3 or power-resource control can remove siblings, lose GPUs, hang drivers/host and require out-of-band recovery.

project_override_considerations: D3hot does not prove D3cold, and a retrain or L1 transition does not prove a device D-state cycle. Setup, forced rebinds and incomplete wakes do not count.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #31 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus function/link/power-resource topology and supported D states
First-fault recovery or clean restored policy/device/host state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test #31 Procedure, Criteria and same-row AI review consistently target D3 power management. Missing D3 variant and power/wake semantics are readiness under-specification, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The D3 objective is clear. Proprietary tooling, D3 variant, topology, wake/function acceptance, evidence and recovery are identifiable prerequisites rather than permanent review blockers.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2134 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00011-V002: approve the exact NVQual Test #31 D3 configuration, PCI-function/root-port/switch/endpoint/GPU/power-resource scope, D3hot versus D3cold target, quiesce/entry/wake source/functional-restoration and latency rules, iterations, link/device/driver and AER/error acceptance, restored policy, first-fault interlocks, and recovery.

review_improvement: Requires proof that the device function and its consumers recover from the intended D3 variant, not merely that a link is visible at the end.
independent_technical_reasoning: D3hot can retain auxiliary power and configuration access, whereas D3cold can remove power and require enumeration and driver recovery. Neither equals L1 or retrain. Each cycle must prove the exact power state and complete function recovery within deadline before another transition can hide a lost device or failed wake.
